decisions.statement: The marker an extended-context model has is `[1m]`.
A wire id ending in the marker is marked.
The marker anywhere but the end of a wire id marks nothing.
The base sibling of a marked wire id is that id with the marker taken off.
The base sibling of an unmarked wire id is that id unchanged.
Only the `model` key of a body decides whether extended context is asked for.
A body naming a model without the marker asks for no extended context.
A body naming no model asks for no extended context.
An absent body asks for no extended context.
A body that will not parse as json asks for no extended context.
A body whose model is no string asks for no extended context.
A rewrite has every key the body has beside the model.
A body naming a model without the marker is rewritten nowhere.
A body that will not parse as json is rewritten nowhere.
Nothing here reads a response status.
Nothing here names which models can have extended context.
A model that is the marker alone is rewritten onto an empty model.
The marker is spelled here rather than read off `@akasha/agent/model-vocab`.

definition: the extended-context marker on the model a request body names
